Chapter 6883: Summon

Chapter 6883: Summon

Spectators knew what was going to happen upon seeing the immortals waiting outside of Stygian. The conflict between Guardian and Devouring was well documented.

Once upon a time, Guardian was weak and couldn’t compete directly. This changed after Mang’s death. Even Zhao Dachui couldn’t stop Guardian from becoming stronger.

Heaven Pit put an end to the rivalry. Devouring fell into obscurity while Guardian continued to ascend. This was amplified during the age of the primordial trees.

Today, Devouring was ruled by someone from the nine worlds. Nevertheless, Gu Chun’s reign was necessary to keep the alliance safe from its enemies.

The fallen immortals from Abyss wore a serious expression.

“Start the call.” Immortal Devourer shouted at Penta-stars.

“We can’t do it without deliberation.” Fire Star said.

“What deliberation, they’re right outside now. Do we need to debate another ten thousand years? The alliance will be gone before then.” Immortal Devourer uttered coldly: “If you can’t decide, then ask Gu Chun. He is the leader and should step up during an existential crisis.”

The five exchanged glances. The issue was that they didn’t know where the emperor was.

“If Dark Realm can’t handle the responsibility, then Devouring Alliance should have a new leader.” Mirage said.

“Nullify their authority and let someone else take charge.” Extinguish added.

“Do it.” Time didn’t allow Dark Realm to hesitate any longer.

As the leader, they had the summoning ability in the alliance.

“Ooo-” The horn sounded across Stygian and even Heavenrealm.

The hidden immortals and overlords all heard this sound and couldn’t resist it.

“Boom!” A pair of black wings spread open with immortal energy.

“Nefarious Immortal, here to answer the call.” The immortal arrived and shouted.

“Rumble!” In an ocean of dead water, a tsunami of insects rushed out of the seabed and devoured everything along the way.

In the center was an immortal riding an insect monarch while carrying a lamp. He gave the impression of an old sage fishing alone next to a river, somehow transcending despite his disgusting companions.

“Bugflood Immortal Monarch answers the call.” He joined the battlefield.

In a lost world in Heavenrealm, a dark eye appeared and everything plunged into a terrible spell. The living beings screamed in agony as the eye devoured their soul and physical essences.

After the feast, it summoned a portal to enter Stygian.

“Apex Heavenly Devil.” The eye pulsed with a terrifying dark light.

In a dead zone of Stygian was a floating mountain of corpses. Corpse energy gathered and formed a beautiful girl capable of seducing any man.

“Godfiend answers the call.” She answered the call. No one would connect her to a corpse due to her gorgeous appearance.

***

“Ten Vagrants Immortals.” Spectators knew who they were.

These immortals have been inactive all this time. They were once famous immortals in Heavenrealm before falling to the darkness.

They also used the number ten to imitate the ten immortal monarchs of Fallen Ten.
